scope: Owner-safe idempotent internal chat command foundation with transactional command/message/event persistence, durable processing, cancellation semantics and transient/replayable SSE
testModeReason: Full regression is mandatory because this card changes ownership/authentication, PostgreSQL schema and privileges, shared task/event protocols, Provider streaming, dependencies and verification infrastructure.

engineeringRegression.discovery: vitest list --json; exact file/fullName equality, all discovered assertions pass without skip
engineeringRegression.dedicatedCardCommand: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: A command is atomically accepted only for the resolved record owner. Anonymous bootstrap and logged-in ownership create exactly one command, USER message, idempotency ledger row and pending task; missing or forged identity, wrong owner and transactional faults leave all Phase016 rows absent.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: Current owner may resume, ARCHIVED rejects, FINALIZED accepts a command without changing record status or final pointers. Missing/expired/forged identity, body owner and revoked session cannot authorize writes.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: The same client key and canonical payload hash replay identical command/message/task IDs with one USER row. A different payload hash yields 409. Concurrent workers claim at most one RUNNING command and at most one terminal winner.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: Events replay by database sequence, including same-millisecond order, and honor Last-Event-ID/afterSequence. Repeated connections return the same window; an exceeded window requires resynchronization without skipped or duplicated persistent events.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: Transient assistant deltas may render live but create zero ChatCommandEvent or chat-message rows. SSE cursors advance only to persisted event IDs, and reconnection replays terminal facts without treating deltas as history.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: Two fixed cancel/complete interleavings produce exactly one database winner. The loser observes CANCELLED or COMPLETED with winner semantics; command, final assistant and terminal-event counts match the winning state.

cases.command: npm run test -- chat-session sse replay cancel
cases.expected: Timeout, rate, cost, network and invalid-result failures retain the accepted USER command/message and write FAILED with a registry errorCode, AiOutputRecord evidence and zero partial assistant message.
Each temporary negative mutation removes a required invariant and turns its targeted fixture red; after restoration the dedicated card command returns green and source hashes are unchanged.

notApplicable: No production traffic, real external credentials, live Provider calls, human review, NLU/Planner implementation, planning UI or legacy API compatibility was required or evaluated.

migrationPolicy.rollback: Keep accepted USER intent and truthful FAILED/CANCELLED command; never keep partial assistant output.

decisions.decision: Store command acceptance, idempotency, task/outbox, events and message linkage transactionally in PostgreSQL 17.
decisions.rationale: Persistent rows are recoverable facts; SSE is disposable transport and cannot determine business state.

decisions.decision: Render transient deltas without persistence and advance cursors only from persisted sequence values.
decisions.rationale: The card distinguishes user experience from durable history and reconnect reconciliation.

decisions.decision: Use database CAS/unique constraints as the sole terminal and replay race authority.
decisions.rationale: Concurrent workers and reconnects require a single database winner and gapless replay source.

commandCorrection.reason: The failed runner treated its own --all orchestration command as a Vitest filter. Execute the three actual isolated mutations and the complete restored card in a separately recorded child process, without changing any business denominator or threshold.

expectationCorrection.originalExpected: Anonymous cookie and authenticated ownership resolve without accepting client-supplied ownership. Valid owners resume; forged cookies, body ownership claims, another user and ARCHIVED records reject with zero writes. FINALIZED accepts only a modification command and transitions MODIFIED in-transaction without creating the Phase060 confirmation artifacts.
expectationCorrection.currentExpected: Current owner may resume, ARCHIVED rejects, FINALIZED accepts a command without changing record status or final pointers. Missing/expired/forged identity, body owner and revoked session cannot authorize writes.
expectationCorrection.reason: The original failed plan contradicted the frozen Phase016 card by transitioning FINALIZED to MODIFIED. The card explicitly requires command admission only, with record/final-version state unchanged; complete version-transition regression belongs to Phase060. Authorization and zero-write rejection coverage are retained and expanded.

retryReason.reason: Both final shells rejected the unsealed attempt-4 checkpoint because unbounded Git batch output exceeded 32 MiB. Bound batches by object size, verify a 36 MiB fixture and late-batch tampering, and preserve the unsealed artifact/metadata pair and raw failures through the existing recovery history protocol. Run the complete new attempt; product results are not reused.
